name: homeos-backend
description: HomeOS 后端服务（NestJS）— 智能家居中央控制平台 API、WebSocket 与 HA 联动

scripts.build: node scripts/patch-nestjs-tree-kill.cjs && node scripts/patch-swc-chokidar-import.cjs && node scripts/patch-nestjs-cli-esm-tree-kill-export.cjs && node scripts/patch-prisma-dev-zeptomatch.cjs && node scripts/ensure-prisma-client.cjs && nest build && node scripts/emit-prisma-generated.cjs && node scripts/fix-dist-imports.cjs
scripts.build:prod: bun ../scripts/bump-version.mjs && node scripts/patch-nestjs-tree-kill.cjs && node scripts/patch-swc-chokidar-import.cjs && node scripts/patch-nestjs-cli-esm-tree-kill-export.cjs && node scripts/patch-prisma-dev-zeptomatch.cjs && node scripts/ensure-prisma-client.cjs && nest build --path ./tsconfig.prod.json && node scripts/emit-prisma-generated.cjs && node scripts/fix-dist-imports.cjs
scripts.start: node scripts/patch-nestjs-tree-kill.cjs && node scripts/patch-swc-chokidar-import.cjs && node scripts/patch-nestjs-cli-esm-tree-kill-export.cjs && node scripts/patch-prisma-dev-zeptomatch.cjs && node scripts/ensure-prisma-client.cjs && node scripts/emit-prisma-generated.cjs && nest start
scripts.start:dev: node scripts/patch-nestjs-tree-kill.cjs && node scripts/patch-swc-chokidar-import.cjs && node scripts/patch-nestjs-cli-esm-tree-kill-export.cjs && node scripts/patch-prisma-dev-zeptomatch.cjs && node scripts/ensure-dist-incremental.cjs && node scripts/ensure-prisma-client.cjs && node scripts/emit-prisma-generated.cjs && nest start --watch
